author: Tariq Mehmood
title: Outstanding winter warmth—no heater needed!
comment: I ordered the Black Rose 2-Ply Double Bed in Royal Maroon. The weight is substantial (over 5kg) and the embossed pattern looks even more regal in person. Islamabad gets quite chilly at night, but with this blanket we turned off our gas heater. Free delivery arrived in 3 days!

author: Ayesha Siddiqui
title: Super soft and feather light for Karachi AC
comment: Glorious Flannel is exactly what I wanted for our bedroom AC. It is very soft on the skin and didn’t shed any lint after the first wash. HBK factory direct pricing is half of what shops in Clifton ask for.

author: Bilal Khan Kakar
title: Survives Quetta -7°C sub-zero winter with ease
comment: The Sultan Imperial 6.2kg is unbelievable. Heavy, luxurious, and locks in heat within 2 minutes of tucking in. Worth every rupee for freezing winter regions.

author: Dr. Fatima Noor
title: Gentlest fabric for our 3-month-old baby
comment: Bought this for my newborn daughter. The inner Sherpa is heavenly soft and does not cause any skin rash. The bear hood is adorable for winter photos. Very hygienic packaging!

author: Usman Ghani
title: Original HBK quality from Peshawar factory hub
comment: My family has used HBK blankets for over 15 years. Ordering online through their website was effortless with Cash On Delivery. Packing was sturdy and clean.

author: Zainab Raza
title: Diamond quilting keeps filler evenly distributed
comment: The Cloud 4-Piece set transformed our master bedroom. It is so warm yet breathable, and matching pillow shams are an elegant touch. Highly recommended!

author: Malik Asad (Hotel GM)
title: Bulk purchase for our guest rooms in Murree
comment: Ordered 40 packs for our hotel resort. They wash cleanly in industrial machines and maintain thickness. Guests continuously praise the warmth.

author: Chaudhry Nadeem Akhtar
title: The centerpiece of my daughter's wedding trousseau (Jahez)
comment: We visited the factory in Faisalabad and ordered the Kohinoor 8kg Bridal Velvet in Mughal Maroon. The golden Zari embroidery and heavy weight of 8 kilograms makes it look like it belongs in a royal palace. The bride's in-laws were immensely impressed by the quality. The leather suitcase presentation is magnificent.

author: Shahid Afridi Jan
title: Deep 3D leaf pattern and exceptional warmth in Swat valley
comment: Sub-zero temperatures in Malam Jabba and Mingora demand serious blankets. The Royal Chinar 5.5kg traps body heat within seconds. The 3D embossing does not flatten even after washing.

author: Haji Ghulam Rasool
title: Blessed geometric patterns with genuine 6kg King size drape
comment: Ordered 3 pieces of Al-Makkah King Size blankets for our home and for gifting. The fabric is 100% pure Korean acrylic and very heavy. Beautifully wrapped with COD delivery right to our doorstep.

author: Dr. Mariam Farooq
title: Super safe 2-way zipper and pure cotton shell
comment: As a pediatrician and mother of a 2-month-old, I am very cautious about newborn bedding. The Little Angels Swaddle is hypoallergenic, pure cotton outside, and very soft Sherpa inside. Essential for winter babies in Punjab.

author: Begum Shazia Mansoor
title: Unrivaled master bridal suite luxury
comment: The Imperial Crest 8-Piece set is simply breathtaking. The embroidery, quilt thickness, and bolster cushions complete the entire master bridal bedroom. Much superior to imported Chinese sets.
